mapper.select: /* JrnlChapterMapper.getDeletedByPostNo */ SELECT entry.post_no AS postNo, entry.regstr_id AS regstr_id, entry.jrnl_day_no AS jrnlDayNo, entry.idx, day.yy AS yy, day.mnth AS mnth FROM jrnl_chapter entry LEFT JOIN jrnl_day day ON entry.jrnl_day_no = day.post_no WHERE entry.post_no = #{postNo}
/* JrnlChapterMapper.findAllForReorder */ SELECT * FROM jrnl_chapter WHERE jrnl_day_no = #{jrnlDayNo} AND del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY idx
